nearest_results: Projected response factors separated writer controllability and output observability.
Aligned joint installation persisted both local reader contrasts but did not test their cross-population relation.
Opposed-label intervention proved direction is regime metadata rather than a live fixed-state command.
novelty_search.new_question: Are the local has/had and is/was contrasts stable affine observations of one upstream temporal state across both task populations, or must the composed program retain task-gated readers?

frozen_analysis.rows: Use all A1/A2/P records from both banks; C is reported separately and never used for fitting.
frozen_analysis.directions: Fit and score present_to_past and past_to_present separately.
frozen_analysis.maps: For each direction and train bank, ordinary least squares c_is = intercept + slope*c_has; score R2 without refit on the other bank. Also fit the reverse c_has from c_is.
frozen_analysis.within_bank: Report Pearson correlation of c_has and c_is for each bank/direction.
frozen_analysis.no_selection: No family, row, residual coordinate, feature, rank, or threshold is selected after inspecting correlations.

bars.within_bank_shared_observation: Absolute Pearson correlation >=0.70 in all four bank-by-direction target cells.
bars.cross_bank_affine_transport: All four train-bank/direction forward maps and all four reverse maps have held-out-bank R2 >=0.50.
bars.control_separation: The median absolute target-cell correlation exceeds the median absolute C-cell correlation by >=0.20.
bars.coverage: Exactly 96 target records and 32 C records, with no model forward, backward, update, grid, or root evaluation.

predictions.pred_a_hash_schema_identity_and_exact_co: Both receipts are hash-bound, aligned records contain exact paired contrasts, and coverage is 96 target plus 32 C rows.
predictions.pred_b_within_bank_shared_temporal_obser: All four target bank/direction correlations pass 0.70.
predictions.pred_c_bidirectional_cross_bank_affine_t: All eight held-out-bank R2 values pass 0.50.
predictions.pred_d_target_over_control_separation: Target median absolute correlation exceeds C median by at least 0.20.
predictions.pred_e_zero_forward_price_and_no_postsel: The audit uses fixed two-scalar affine maps only and zero GPU/model/search work.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: compile one shared upstream temporal scalar with task-specific observation and writer maps.
terminal.null: A/E pass but B/C/D misses: retain explicit task-gated readers; do not force a shared scalar by rank or feature search.
terminal.invalid: Authority, identity, coverage, finiteness, or price fails.
